title: Quaint Grilled Croatian Butter Beans Toast
description: A hearty post-workout Croatian dish featuring butter beans and toast, served in a Korean brass bowl, with a grassy and crumbly texture, this plant-based friendly meal is perfect for a quick snack.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Drain and rinse the butter beans, then set them aside.
Brush the bread slices with olive oil on both sides.
Season the bread slices with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Grill the bread slices for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
In a bowl, mix together the butter beans, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
To assemble the dish, place the grilled bread slices in a Korean brass bowl, then top with the butter bean mixture.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
